rubric.name: correctness
rubric.guidance: This is a fractal explorer: wrong math, an off-by-one in iteration or pixel mapping, a render that silently draws the wrong region, or a UI state that desyncs from the canvas outranks every other finding. Server and client boundaries in Next.js must stay correct (no browser-only APIs in server code, no server-only secrets in client code).

rubric.name: deploy-contract
rubric.guidance: The container contract the deploy system depends on must hold: a root Dockerfile, the server listens on $PORT (8080), the /api/health route returns 200 with a JSON body, and no secret or environment-specific value is baked into the image or the repo. Flag any change that breaks one of these without an explicit bead requirement.

rubric.name: tests
rubric.guidance: Rendering and math logic must have tests that would fail if the logic regressed; tests must run without network or a browser. Do not accept a test edited to pass or a snapshot regenerated without explanation.

rubric.name: test-engineering
rubric.guidance: Test debt is a finding (standard: ~/.claude/docs/standards/test-engineering.md). MAJOR: an unbounded wait or loop; a timeout, budget or ratchet raised to land the change; a test that runs a script or binary in a subprocess without reading it, so the result cache serves a stale pass; sleep used to synchronise; a failing test retried or skipped to pass; a clock baseline read after the launch it times; a test that asserts implementation details so a refactor breaks it. MINOR: a test over its tier's cost; a fixture rebuilt for every case; a family of near-identical slow cases; a failure message that names no cause; shared state or ordering between tests. Phrase test findings as static hypotheses from the code, never as 'fails when run'.

rubric.name: dependency-hygiene
rubric.guidance: package.json and package-lock.json changes must be explained: which package, why, and whether it is a major bump. next stays on the 16.x line unless a bead says otherwise. An audit fix that pulls a major bump with no note is a finding.

rubric.name: no-credentials
rubric.guidance: No secret, key, token or credential in the repo, tests or logs, and no code path that needs a cloud credential to build or pass its gate.
